original_test_intent: Set an approved chassis-capability and device-address vector, prove persistence/readback, and restore the original nonvolatile values.
original_method: Preserved source is invalid 0x06/0x05/no-data; corrected execution requires approved Chassis 0x00/0x05 with the full target-specific vector.
manual_activity: Platform owner approves every capability/address field and an independent recovery and restore path.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek recognizes a raw payload is needed but leaves the invalid source command unresolved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved Chassis 0x00/0x05 only after full-vector baseline and field validation, then read back and restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Invalid source bytes, Script and timing preserved as evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline every capability/device-address field, write one approved vector, prove persistence and effects, and restore exactly.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects command family and adds mandatory payload/readback in Review layer.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Completion alone cannot prove nonvolatile fields or device discovery remain correct.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong addresses or flags can corrupt platform management topology until restored.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it controls and returns every source capability/address field with equal persistence and restore evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title requires Chassis Set Capabilities, while Procedure uses Application NetFn 0x06 and omits the mandatory capability/address data.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended setter is identifiable; platform vector and authorization are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents an invalid empty write and requires full nonvolatile vector verification and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Capability flags and FRU/SDR/SEL/system/bridge addresses form one topology contract. Partial comparison is unsafe because a syntactically accepted vector can redirect management discovery or advertise unsupported functions; every field and the restored baseline must be verified together.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code, setter and IB counterpart search
